provenance.description: Authored hosting incident for development. All identifiers, customer statements, and log entries are fictional; this is not a reproduced fault or a real customer ticket.

incident.title: Website shows a gateway error after a restart
incident.description: Our site started showing Bad Gateway around 10:00 UTC. We restarted the application from the hosting panel a few minutes earlier. Static images still load, but the home page and login fail. We cannot tell whether the application finished starting.

context.reported_change: Customer reports an application restart shortly before the failures; not independently verified.
context.reported_impact: Dynamic pages unavailable; static assets reportedly accessible.
